portal.title: Your account
portal.notAvailable: This is not available to you yet.
portal.afterActivation: Claiming a record, filing a grievance and downloading your data become available once your account is active.

signIn.title: Sign in or create an account
signIn.intro: We send a one-time code to your mobile number. The same steps sign you in or create your sign-in account.
signIn.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +91 followed by your number.
signIn.phoneBad: Enter the number with a plus sign and the country code, using digits only.
signIn.sendFailed: The code could not be sent. Check the number and try again in a moment.
signIn.sent: A code was sent if the number can receive one.
signIn.codeFailed: That code did not work. Check it and try again, or ask for a new one.

register.title: Create your patient account
register.body: You are signed in, but you do not have a patient account here yet. Creating it does not link you to any record.
register.refused: This sign-in cannot be used for a patient account.

consent.title: Notices and your decisions
consent.none: No notice has been published yet.
consent.confirmBody: Your decision is recorded against the version shown above, with the time.
consent.changed: The notice changed while you were reading. The page will refresh; please read the new version.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.body: You can activate your account once you have granted the care-delivery notice.
activate.confirmBody: Activates your account if the required decision has been recorded.
activate.consent_required: The care-delivery notice has not been granted yet, so the account was not activated.

claim.title: Link your record
claim.body: To see your own record, give the name and date of birth the hospital has for you. This also needs a verified mobile number.
claim.alreadyLinked: Your account is linked to a record.
claim.name: Full name
claim.confirmBody: We compare what you give with the record that matches your verified mobile number. If it does not match for certain, a person at the hospital decides.
claim.refused: This cannot be done for this account: it must be active and have a verified mobile number.
claim.unavailable: This is not available right now. Nothing was recorded.
claim.invalid: Check the name and date of birth. Nothing was recorded.

outcome.pending_review: Your request was received. A person at the hospital will decide.
outcome.locked: Too many attempts. Please try again later or contact the hospital.
outcome.already_bound: Your account is already linked to a record.

grievance.title: Send a request or a complaint
grievance.body: Use this for access, correction, erasure, a nominee, or any other request. A person at the hospital reads it.
grievance.categoryHint: A code from the hospital's list (lowercase letters, digits and underscores). The hospital tells you which codes exist.
grievance.text: What you want to tell us
grievance.confirmBody: This sends your message to the hospital. It is stored encrypted.
grievance.refused: This cannot be done for this account: it must be active and linked to a record of that clinic.
grievance.categoryRefused: That category is not on the hospital's list. Nothing was sent.
grievance.unavailable: This is not available right now (the category list or the encryption is not set up). Nothing was sent.

myData.title: Download my data
myData.body: Downloads one file with everything the system holds about you that you may see. Each download is recorded.
myData.done: Your file was downloaded. It holds:
myData.truncated: The file does not hold everything: some lists were cut short.

count.grievances: messages you sent to the hospital: {{count}}
